==Format==
* '''Play-In''' - ''August 5<sup>th</sup> - August 11<sup>th</sup>''
** Double Elimination bracket
** All matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo3}} except for the {{Abbr/Bo5}} Lower Bracket Final.
** <span class="bg-up">Top 3 teams</span> qualify to Playoffs.
** <span class="mw-customtoggle-Seeding-Pots" style="border-bottom:1px dotted;">''Click here for detailed information about Seeding''</span>
<div class="toccolours mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-Seeding-Pots" style="margin-top:10px;">
* Teams are splited into 2 seed pools to ensure quality brackets.
** 8 teams from 3 leagues are splited into 2 pools
*** '''Pool 1''' will consist of the top 4 teams, namely: '''CFO''' (PCS#3), '''FAK''' (PCS#4), '''DFM''' (LJL#2), '''GZ''' (LCO#1);
*** '''Pool 2''' will consist of the 5th to 8th teams, namely: '''JT''' (PCS#5), '''WPE''' (PCS#6), '''SG''' (LJL#3), '''TB''' (LCO#2);
* Two PCS teams of Pool 1 will not be drawn into the same bracket.
* Teams from LJL and LCO will not be drwan into the same bracket.
* The draw show was held after the last game of PCS Summer Regular Season.
</div>

* '''Playoffs''' - ''August 14<sup>th</sup> - September 1<sup>st</sup>''
** Double Elimination bracket
** PCS#1 and LJL#1 (PSG  and SHG) receive a bye to Upper Bracket Round 2 while PCS#1 can select the opponent in this round.
** PCS#2 (DCG) can select the opponent in Upper Bracket Round 1.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
** Top 2 teams qualify for [[World Championship/2024|Worlds 2024]].
